final.answer: Lionel Messi has had a legendary career, primarily associated with FC Barcelona, where he spent the vast majority of his professional life. His notable transfers include his move from FC Barcelona to Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) in 2021, and his subsequent move to Inter Miami CF in 2023. Throughout his career, he has played under world-class managers such as Pep Guardiola, Luis Enrique, and Lionel Scaloni (for the Argentina national team). He has shared the pitch with iconic teammates like Xavi, Andrés Iniesta, Neymar, and Luis Suárez. While referees are numerous and vary by match, his career has been officiated by top-tier referees in La Liga, Ligue 1, MLS, and international tournaments like the FIFA World Cup and Copa América.
